newsitem.title: GERMANY: German insolvencies to rise 14 pct in '97 - Hermes.
newsitem.headline: German insolvencies to rise 14 pct in '97 - Hermes.

text.p: The wave of German business insolvencies will crest higher in 1997, with 29,000 firms likely to go out of business, up 14 percent on last year, the Hermes state credit guarantee agency said on Thursday.
Hermes said in a statement that insolvencies would jump by 28 percent to 9,500 in the formerly-communist states of eastern Germany, and by eight percent to 19,500 in the prosperous west.
Hardest hit is likely to be the building sector, where a total of 8,800 insolvencies are expected, a rise of 25 percent.
